name: Financial Assistance for encouraging production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr
benefit:
##### ***Financial Assistance for Staging Performances***

- Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for staging four shows.
- Payment will be made directly to the applicant after a statement of expenditure enclosing all original bills (with stamped receipts if the amount exceeds ₹5,000/-) is submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa.

##### ***Infrastructure Support***

-
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a dramatic troupe or an individual producing Khell-Tiatrs. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should be a new or old script. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must conform to the traditional format of the Khell-Tiatr. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must be one in which just one-story flows from beginning to end with an interval of 10 to 15 minutes. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must have 12 to 14 cantos which are related to the theme of the play. - Out of these cantos, at least 7 must be of an interactive nature. - The band for the Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should include at least two blowing instruments, one keyboard, one bass guitar, and a drum set. - The applicant must not have any adverse remark made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc. - The applicant must not have anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.
